[size=5][b]Documentation:[/b]
[/size]
[u][size=4][b]Config:[/b][/size][/u]
[color=#a4c2f4][b]"MakeAllFoxesPickableFromTheStart" [/b][/color](standard = [color=#ea9999]false[/color])
turn to[color=#b6d7a8] true[/color], if you want to select later or whimsical foxes as a starter pet

[b][color=#a4c2f4]"MakeAllFoxesCheapToAddopt"[/color][/b] (standard = [color=#ea9999]false[/color])
turn to [color=#b6d7a8]true[/color], if you want the price for adoption to be really cheap
(normal is 50.000 - 100.000, cheap is 500 - 1.000)

[color=#a4c2f4]"HaveWhimsicalColouredFoxes"[/color] (standard = [color=#b6d7a8]true[/color])
turn to [color=#ea9999]false[/color], if you [b]don't[/b] want the whimsical foxes in your game [b]>:c[/b]

[size=4][u][b]Infos:[/b][/u][/size]
The fox pet is implemented as [color=#ffe599][b]it's own pet breed[/b][/color].
currently foxes do not like wearing hats (similar to turtles).
It currently behaves a lot like the cat in the game. (I might add more unique fox actions in the future)
When making a [b][color=#ffe599]new farm[/color][/b], you can choose one of the [color=#ffe599][b]5 starter foxes[/b][/color] as your first pet.
All foxes will be available for purchase from Marnie when [b][color=#ffe599]pet adoption[/color][/b] is unlocked.

[b][u][size=4]For translators and expanders:
[/size][/u][/b]Feel free to create and release a translation or expansion for this mod.
Please [color=#ea9999][b]don't[/b][/color] use ANY AI in your translation or expansion and on your mod page ([b][color=#ea9999]no[/color][/b] AI pictures or anything).
Please [color=#ea9999][b]don't[/b][/color] reuse/reupload my assets or code.
Feel free to create replacement mods for my assets (e.g. cuter fox sprites :3)
Feel free to create mods that add more Foxes (the [i]WhimsicalFoxes.json [/i]file in my mod is a good example for that)
